messages:
sophia.k: thanks everyone for the all-hands walkthrough — quick follow-ups on the product roadmap items (API / Console / Optimize). got a couple of timeline & canary questions.
lia.pm: fire away — can answer product timelines, will loop in eng for rollout details.
sophia.k: 1) API: you mentioned 'latency-focused' model variants landing in next release. when should teams expect the new rate-limit behavior and pricing delta? will there be a migration window or opt-in flag?
lia.pm: API rate-limit changes are planned as an opt-in beta first. target: beta in ~6 weeks, broad opt-in after 8–10 weeks depending on telemetry. pricing delta will be communicated before beta start — aim is transparency.
matt.engineering: to add — the beta will expose a feature flag `prefer-latency-variant=true` and a new header `x-redwood-model-variant`. sample config: ```json
{ "preferLatencyVariant": true, "batching": "auto" }
```
sophia.k: nice, will that header be honored on Dedicated & Private?
matt.engineering: yes, will be honored on all modes; Dedicated may have different capacity constraints so routing might fallback to standard variant if no compatible pool.
sophia.k: 2) Console GA for the per-route cost & latency dashboard — rough window? also will historic data be backfilled?
lia.pm: Console per-route cost/latency is targeted for GA in the next quarter. beta invites to platform admins in ~4 weeks. we will backfill up to 90 days of metrics for customers on hosted plans; Dedicated/Private will see metrics from the point of agent upgrade.
alex.cto: priority is to ship a stable surface first (cost + p50/p95). advanced tracing and token-level drilldowns after GA.
sophia.k: 3) Optimize auto-batching suggestions — will that change inference semantics or just runtime config suggestions?
lia.pm: Optimize will only suggest config changes (batch sizes, kv-cache policies, quantization profiles). no output-altering model rewrites. suggestions will include expected cost delta and a conservative latency estimate.
matt.engineering: operational note — suggestions are generated from sampled production traces; they will appear in Console under Optimize > Suggestions and can be applied via one-click or API.
sophia.k: last — canary policy for all three surfaces? how do we handle rollback & alerts?
matt.engineering: standard canary flow: 5% traffic for 24h -> 25% for 48h -> ramp. automatic rollback on SLA regressions (error rate > 1% or p95 latency +30% relative). alerts go to eng-oncall + the release channel.
lia.pm: we'll publish a brief FAQ and migration checklist before beta starts. cc @sophia.k if you want to run a cross-team readout for platform & infra.
sophia.k: yes please — happy to sync with platform and infra. can we get the beta invite list & docs link when available?
lia.pm: will post docs + invite list in #eng-releases and share here (ETA 4 weeks). :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled for canary wave 1 at 2026-05-18T07:00:00Z to cluster-us-east-1 (dry-run).
alex.cto: also: if anyone expects breaking integrations from the header/flag change, flag now — we can extend beta duration.
sophia.k: thanks all — this helps a lot. i’ll gather questions from infra & platform and follow up in a short thread.
lia.pm: great, thanks!
matt.engineering: thanks — will prep the feature flag docs and example curl snippets for the beta.
notes: thread is a short all-hands followup Q&A about timelines, betas, and rollouts for API, Console, and Optimize features
